overall_reason: A shadcn and Tailwind v4 token layer (20 of 20 shadcn roles, one --spacing base, one --radius) carries the page: six text colours, two border colours, a 20px card radius and pills, with no near-duplicate colours at any width.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY, T-SCALE-FIT and T-DRIFT-PAIRS pass on the page's own components (colour declarations 90% var, spacing 97% var, no near-duplicate colours); the stray values are host chrome and three bracketed type one-offs, and there is no second theme to check.

findings.where: stylesheet utility classes; hero h1 and small labels, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: The stylesheet carries bracketed type one-offs beside the Tailwind scale: .text-[11px], .text-[0.8rem] and .leading-[1.02] (declarations.arbitrary_value_selectors). values.1440.font_size shows 11px on 3 elements next to the 12px step used by 49 elements, and line heights run in 8 ratios (1.35, 1.45, 1.6, 1.4, 1.5, 1.0, 1.2, 1.55) for 8 sizes.
findings.before: 11px and 0.8rem labels and an arbitrary 1.02 leading beside text-xs and the framework leading steps
findings.after: Small labels on text-xs (12px) and the display leading on a named step of the theme
findings.why: Three bracketed type values sit outside a scale that otherwise holds, so the next component has no rule for which small size to use.

strengths: One spacing base: 207 references to --spacing, and spacing declarations are 97% var.
Colour roles come from the shadcn semantic layer (--background, --foreground, --brand, --accent with foreground pairs); 90% of colour declarations use var().
One card radius (20px on 19 cards at 1440) and pills for chips and buttons, the same at 375.
not_investigated: T-THEME-PARITY: no dark or alternate theme is declared in the readable CSS.
One stylesheet was unreadable (stylesheet.unreadable_sheets 1): its tokens and rules are unknown.
z-index 1000000 and the 'Edit with Lovable' badge are host chrome, not the page's components; left out.
24 undeclared references (--sidebar-width, --radix-*) belong to unused shadcn component code and are set by script at runtime; not judged.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a landing page for an AI tool recommender); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
